UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

Material class descriptor — palette source + paint recipe + PBR tuning for one family of belt rock.

key

Seed/texture key.

color

Packed hex base color the texture derives its shades from.

p

Pick probability (the five must sum to 1).

roughness

Material roughness — metal reads glossier than regolith.

metalness

Material metalness — only the metal class is truly metallic.

_CLASSES

The five belt material classes, mirroring real asteroid taxonomy — stony chondrites dominate, carbonaceous next, dust/ice/metal trail.

rockTexture

Paints one material-class texture: base fill + per-class features — crater pits for stone, specular veins for metal, fracture streaks for ice, nothing but grain for carbon/dust.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param cls Material class descriptor.
  • @param rand Seeded RNG.
  • @returns CanvasTexture or undefined when 2d is unavailable.

rockGeometry

Builds one unique rock geometry — either a crumpled icosahedron (irregular body) or a sheared tetrahedron (collision fragment). Vertices are displaced radially by seeded value noise, then per- vertex spherical UVs (u = atan2 longitude, v = asin latitude) are baked so the class texture wraps the body like a moon map.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param frag True → tetrahedral fragment shape.
  • @param rand Seeded RNG for this individual rock.

pickClass

Picks a material class for one rock from the cumulative probability table (metal holds the implicit remainder of the four named classes).

  • @param rand Seeded RNG.

makeBeltRocks

Populates an asteroid-belt definition with hero rock meshes — the particle annulus stays as the mass background, these give the belt its readable "rocks drifting past" foreground on fly-in.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def The belt's catalog entry — def.belt sizes the annulus.
  • @returns group of rock pivots + pivots satPivots entries.
